company.name: 喬富科技股份有限公司

items.text: Develop, operate, and monitor ETL and real-time data pipelines for data collection, cleansing, processing, storage, and analytics
Design and maintain data schemas, and perform database performance tuning
Develop backend APIs and maintain data visualization platforms for SHOPLINE merchants
Fluent in Python and SQL; experience with API frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Django) is a plus
Expertise in designing and developing ETL and real-time streaming jobs (Apache Airflow preferred)
Solid experience with real-time data processing and stream-processing systems, such as Apache Flink, RisingWave, and Apache Kafka
Proficient in SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with TiDB, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB is a plus
Experience with cloud services such as AWS / GCP, especially data-related services
Familiar with Linux/Unix environments and containerization tools such as Docker / Kubernetes
It’s a plus if you have experience in the e-commerce industry and strong skills in data analysis

description.text:

- It’s a plus if you have experience in the e-commerce industry and strong skills in data analysis
